html:
Unique Research · Insight / Earnings · May 27, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

FY2021 (filed Feb 16’22): rev $4.612B (+57.4% YoY; ’19–’21 +47% / +86% / +57%), NI $2.915B (includes ~$2.856B unrealized investment gains), GM ~54–55%. Merchant solutions ~70% of rev; SaaS subscription $1.34B (+47.7%) driven by merchant count/MRR. Merchant-solutions GM rose to 42.9% ’21 from 37.6% ’19. Omnichannel stack: online, mobile, POS; inventory, payments, fulfillment, CRM, analytics, capital. Charts in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
